product.title: Private Boat Charter Key West, Dolphin Tour, Snorkeling & Sandbar

description.text: Escape the crowds and discover hidden sandbars on a private eco tour through Key West’s backcountry waters. Swim, snorkel, or simply relax on pristine beaches only accessible by boat, with a flexible itinerary customized just for you.• Watch wild dolphins in their natural habitat• Private eco-friendly tour, just for your group• Cruise Key West’s beautiful backcountry waters• Flexible departure times to fit your schedule• Learn about marine life from a local guide Equipment, beverages, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the water and island scenery. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
